instruction.name: fcvt.ud.d
instruction.description: Convert double in fj to the upper 16 bits of x87 80-bit extended format.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fcvt.ud.d $f0, $f8; fcvt.ud.d $f1, $f9; fcvt.ud.d $f2, $f10; fcvt.ud.d $f3, $f11; fcvt.ud.d $f4, $f12; fcvt.ud.d $f5, $f13; fcvt.ud.d $f6, $f14; fcvt.ud.d $f7, $f15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'fcvt.ud.d $f0, $f8; fcvt.ud.d $f1, $f9; fcvt.ud.d $f2, $f10; fcvt.ud.d $f3, $f11; fcvt.ud.d $f4, $f12; fcvt.ud.d $f5, $f13; fcvt.ud.d $f6, $f14; fcvt.ud.d $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 4.00 cycles, i.e. 0.5 CPI. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000); larger unroll factors inflated the value through L1I pressure.
